title: 2020 HMMT February Algebra and Number Theory Problem 1
statement: Let \(P(x)=x^{3}+x^{2}-r^{2} x-2020\) be a polynomial with roots \(r, s, t\). What is \(P(1)\) ?

solutions.text:
Vieta's formulas give the following equations:

\[\begin{aligned}
r+s+t & =-1 \\
r s+s t+t r & =-r^{2} \\
r s t & =2020 .
\end{aligned}\]

The second equation is \((r+t)(r+s)=0\). Without loss of generality, let \(r+t=0\). Then \(s=r+s+t=-1\). Finally \(r^{2}=r s t=2020\), so \(P(1)=-4038\).
